status.error: Not saved. The previous setting still applies.

state.slow: Loading is taking longer than usual.
state.errorTitle: This part could not be loaded.

errors.generic: That did not work. Your entries are still here; please try again.
errors.signInRequired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.sessionNotFresh: For your security, sign in again and then try again.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 12 characters.
errors.passwordTooLong: The password can have at most 128 characters.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.nameTooShort: The name needs at least 2 characters.
errors.nameTooLong: The name can have at most 80 characters.
errors.usernameInvalid: Only lowercase letters, digits, full stop, hyphen and underscore, 3 to 30 characters.
errors.usernameTaken: This username is already taken. Choose another one.
errors.codeInvalid: The code is not correct. Enter the current code from your app.
errors.notificationLocked: This notification cannot be turned off.
errors.passkeyCancelled: You cancelled adding it. Nothing was saved.
errors.passkeyUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
errors.blockNotFound: This block no longer exists. The list is now up to date.

profile.intro: This is how providers see you and how you appear in your reviews.
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHint: First name or a name of your choice, 2 to 80 characters.
profile.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, full stop, hyphen and underscore, 3 to 30 characters.
profile.emailHint: The email address cannot be changed here.

security.intro: Password, second factor, passkeys and the devices you are signed in on.

password.title: Password
password.revokeOthersHint: All other sessions end; this device stays signed in.
password.savedRevoked: Password changed. Other devices are signed out.

twoFactor.title: Second factor
twoFactor.intro: When you sign in, we also ask for a code from an authenticator app.
twoFactor.enabled: The second factor is set up.
twoFactor.disabled: The second factor is not set up.
twoFactor.scanStep: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.codeHint: 6 digits, the code changes every 30 seconds.
twoFactor.backupIntro: Each backup code lets you sign in once if you cannot reach the app. Keep them safe; we only show them now.
twoFactor.disableConfirmText: Your password will then be enough to sign in. Your backup codes stop working; to set it up again you will need a new QR code.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: With a passkey you sign in by unlocking your device, without a password.
passkeys.removeConfirmText: You will no longer be able to sign in with this passkey. Your password and other passkeys keep working.
passkeys.emptyText: Add a passkey to sign in without a password.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.intro: Devices and browsers you are currently signed in on.
sessions.revokeConfirmText: The device is signed out immediately. Whoever uses it has to sign in again.
sessions.emptyText: You are only signed in on this device.

log.title: Change log
log.intro: What changed in your account security, without IP addresses and without content.
log.emptyText: Sign-ins and security changes appear here.

privacy.intro: Every change applies immediately. The default is the more private choice.
privacy.visibility: Who can see your member profile
privacy.visibilityNobodyHint: Providers still see your name in requests and messages.
privacy.onlineStatusHint: Others see when you are active.
privacy.readReceiptsHint: Others see when you have read their message.

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.intro: People you block can no longer write to you or start a new conversation. They are not told.
blocked.emptyText: When you block someone in a conversation, they appear here until you unblock them.

notifications.intro: Choose for each event how we reach you. Every change applies immediately.
notifications.pushNote: Push notifications are not available yet. Until then we reach you by email.
notifications.securityLocked: This is the only way you learn about sign-ins on new devices.
notifications.discretion: Email subjects mention neither names nor content.

appearance.intro: Every change applies immediately and stays saved in this account.
appearance.reducedMotionHint: Transitions and animations are left out.
appearance.neutralTitleHint: The browser tab only shows “Overview”, whichever page is open.

data.intro: Download your data, deactivate your account or request deletion.
data.exportText: A JSON file with your profile, your settings and the change log. Password, keys and session tokens are not included.
data.exportRateLimited: You have just exported your data. Try again in an hour.
data.deactivateText: Pauses your account. A public profile is hidden. When you sign in again, everything is as before.
data.deactivateConfirmText: All sessions end immediately, including on this device, and a public profile is hidden. When you sign in again, the account is active again.
data.deactivated: Your account is deactivated. Sign in to use it again.
data.deleteText: We delete your account and all data after a period of 30 days. Until then you can cancel the request by signing in.
data.deleteConfirmText: All sessions end immediately and your account is deactivated from now on. On {date} we permanently delete the account and all data; after that it cannot be undone. If you sign in before then, the request is cancelled.
data.deleted: Deletion requested. If you sign in within 30 days, the request is cancelled.
